source_directory: TG Market public country/news and politics catalogues; TGScope country catalogues; Telemetrio India/Bangladesh politics catalogues; public Telegram previews
notice: All entries are discovery leads, not verified endorsements. Party, movement, advocacy, commentary, aggregator and mirror accounts are actor/viewpoint-originated sources and not independent corroboration. Directory and public-preview labels are approximate. All entries remain UNREVIEWED_CANDIDATE and disabled for collection until analyst review.
